state.seed_assertion: When relying on the disproportionate effort exception for not providing privacy information, controllers must be able to justify this and take other measures to protect people's rights.

sentences.1: When relying on the disproportionate effort exception for not providing privacy information, controllers must be able to justify this and take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.2: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.3: Processing personal data not obtained directly from the data subject, where the controller relies on Article 14.5(b) impossibility or disproportionate effort, requires a DPIA when combined with other criteria.
sentences.4: Invisible processing occurs when personal data is obtained from sources other than directly from the individual and privacy information required by Article 14 is not provided.
sentences.5: 'Invisible processing' occurs when you obtain personal data from somewhere other than directly from the individual themselves, and you don't provide them with the privacy information required by Article 14.
sentences.6: Invisible processing: processing of personal data that has not been obtained direct from the data subject in circumstances where the controller considers that compliance with Article 14 would prove impossible or involve disproportionate effort.
sentences.7: Invisible processing occurs when personal data is obtained from sources other than the data subject directly without providing Article 14 privacy information.
sentences.8: 'Invisible processing' occurs when you obtain personal data from somewhere other than directly from the individual themselves, and you don't provide them with the privacy information required by Article 14.
sentences.9: When processing involves the use of data obtained from third parties, controllers must carefully consider whether they can provide privacy information to individuals.
sentences.10: Data protection compliance measures are a good measure of necessity and proportionality and should include lawful basis, prevention of function creep, data quality, data minimisation, privacy information provision, support for individual rights, processor compliance measures, and safeguards for international transfers.
sentences.11: the measures and safeguards taken to protect individuals;
sentences.12: The advice and recommendations of the DPO should be recorded in a DPIA where relevant and the DPIA should be signed off by appropriate people.
